Marvel Cosmic Invasion is an upcoming beat 'em up game developed by Tribute Games and published by Dotemu.
Marvel Cosmic Invasion is scheduled to be released for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2 in 2025.
Gameplay
Marvel Cosmic Invasion is an arcade-style beat 'em up game where players control a variety of Marvel superheroes to battle through hordes of enemies. The game features both single-player and multiplayer modes, allowing players to team up with friends in cooperative gameplay. Players can select from a roster of 15 characters, including Spider-Man, Captain America, and Wolverine, each with their own unique abilities.
The game includes dynamic tag-team combat mechanics, allowing players to switch between characters during battles, enhancing the strategic depth of gameplay. Players will face off against powerful enemies across various iconic locations, including New York City and the Negative Zone, while attempting to thwart the villain Annihilus' cosmic invasion.
Development
The game was developed by Tribute Games in collaboration with Dotemu, with the goal of creating a fast-paced, action-packed beat 'em up experience that would appeal to both Marvel fans and classic gaming enthusiasts. The developers have drawn inspiration from classic arcade games while incorporating modern gameplay elements to ensure a fresh and exciting experience for players.
Release
Marvel Cosmic Invasion will be released for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2 in 2025.
